intro.sr: Administrator može da premesti termin na drugog zaposlenog. Sistem sam filtrira listu - zaposleni koji je već zauzet u tom terminu se uopšte ne pojavljuje kao opcija, umesto da se ponudi pa odbije.
intro.en: An admin can move an appointment to a different employee. The system filters the list itself - an employee already busy at that time simply doesn't appear as an option, instead of being offered and then rejected.

admin-prijava.sr: Administrator se prijavljuje na svoj nalog.
admin-prijava.en: The admin logs into their account.

admin-ulazak-otvara-nalog-meni.sr: Administrator klikne na dropdown sa svojim imenom u gornjem desnom uglu.
admin-ulazak-otvara-nalog-meni.en: The admin clicks the dropdown showing their name in the top-right corner.

admin-ulazak-otvara-admin-panel.sr: Administrator bira „Admin panel” iz menija, čime se otvara admin deo sajta.
admin-ulazak-otvara-admin-panel.en: The admin picks "Admin panel" from the menu, opening the site's admin area.

admin-termini-otvara-meni.sr: Administrator klikne na grupu „Zakazivanje” u admin meniju.
admin-termini-otvara-meni.en: The admin clicks the "Scheduling" group in the admin menu.

admin-termini-bira-stavku.en: The admin picks "Appointments" from the menu.

admin-termini-pretraga.sr: Administrator pretražuje listu po email adresi klijenta da bi pronašao termin koji treba premestiti.
admin-termini-pretraga.en: The admin searches the list by the customer's email to find the appointment that needs to move.

admin-termini-otvaranje-rezultata.en: The admin opens the appointment's details.

premestanje-na-slobodnog.sr: Administrator bira slobodnog zaposlenog iz padajuće liste i potvrđuje promenu.
premestanje-na-slobodnog.en: The admin picks a free employee from the dropdown and confirms the change.

admin-ponovo-otvara-meni.sr: Administrator se vraća u meni da još jednom proveri termin.
admin-ponovo-otvara-meni.en: The admin returns to the menu to check the appointment once more.

admin-ponovo-bira-stavku.en: The admin opens the appointments list again.

admin-ponovo-pretraga.sr: Administrator ponovo pretražuje po istom klijentu.
admin-ponovo-pretraga.en: The admin searches for the same customer again.

admin-ponovo-otvaranje-rezultata.sr: Administrator ponovo otvara isti termin, sada da proveri padajuću listu za dodelu.
admin-ponovo-otvaranje-rezultata.en: The admin reopens the same appointment, this time to check the assignment dropdown.

zauzet-zaposleni-nije-ponudjen.sr: U padajućoj listi, zaposleni koji je u tom terminu već zauzet negde drugde se uopšte ne pojavljuje - sistem ga je unapred izbacio iz opcija.
zauzet-zaposleni-nije-ponudjen.en: In the dropdown, an employee already booked elsewhere at that exact time simply isn't listed - the system filtered them out in advance.
